Name: Static Inventory Redux
Author: maxxhaxxs
Description:
[b]Static Inventory[/b] keeps your inventory in the same order throughout all of the menus. While still being able to shift around your toolbar in-game.

[img]https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nrobinson12/StaticInventory/master/StaticInventory/assets/demo.gif[/img]


Love the feature of being able to swap your toolbar to see & use different rows in your inventory? Hate the fact that it also shifts around your actual inventory in the menus? Look no further! This mod will keep your inventory static while you are swapping your toolbar as your heart desires!

[b]Install[/b]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Use[/b]
As soon as you load a save it will start working! [b]Static Inventory[/b] will take your current toolbar row and use that as your first row in your inventory.

[b]If you want a different first row:
[/b]
[list]
[*]Swap over to the row you'd like to be first in your toolbar.[/*]
[*]Open the menu screen and tab over to settings. Scrolling all the way down, click on [b]Static Inventory: Make current row first[/b].[/*]
[*]Your first row should be changed![/*]
[/list]
[b]Incompatible With[/b]
These are mods that I have tested and found they are incompatible with [b]Static Inventory[/b]. I am actively developing and working on compatibility fixes for these mods.
[list]
[*]Better Chests[/*]
[*]Bigger Backpack[/*]
[/list]
